Add idempotency key to refund endpoint

Clients retry POST /v1/refunds on timeouts. Store the Idempotency-Key header for 24 h and return the first response for a repeated key.

40pub async fn create_refund(
41 State(app): State<AppState>,
42 headers: HeaderMap,
43 Json(req): Json<CreateRefundRequest>,
44) -> Result<Json<RefundResponse>, ApiError> {
45 let key = IdempotencyKey::from_headers(&headers)?;
46 if let Some(cached) = app.idempotency.get(&key).await? {
47 return Ok(Json(cached));
48 }
49 let payment = app.payments.find(req.payment_id).await?;
50 if req.amount > payment.refundable() {
51 return Err(ApiError::bad_request("amount exceeds refundable balance"));
52 }
53 let refund = app.ledger.refund(&payment, req.amount, &key).await?;
54 let body: RefundResponse = refund.into();
55 app.idempotency.put(&key, &body, TTL_24H).await?;
56 Ok(Json(body))
57}
